page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using the AMD EPYC 9T24 processor, operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include any local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes, and network bandwidth is rated at a baseline of 10 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.g8a.8xlarge demonstrates strong single-core and multi-core performance. It achieves top-tier results in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, alongside a strong Passmark memory score of 2858.75. Cryptographic capabilities are also notable, with the Passmark CPU encryption test scoring in the top 25% at 38554.37, aided by hardware-accelerated instruction sets such as AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. Multi-core stress-ng performance and database operations fall within the average range, indicating stable execution under sustained parallel workloads.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is the complete absence of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware, which limits its utility for high-speed local caching or deep learning workloads. However, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio offer solid qualitative cost efficiency for standard enterprise workloads. The ecs.g8a.8xlarge is well-suited for general-purpose applications, including web serving, software compilation, text and image processing, and medium-scale database operations.
